decisions: CSharp NormalizeEnumOuterOwnerScopes normalizes an outer owner absent on one returned match edge. Restore the exact live edge LocalScope and call canonical DropOwnedLocal, preserving prior field moves, borrowed and mutable storage rules. Restore prior emitter scope after insertion; no new drop algorithm. CSharp8 passes both success and error paths after fixing C796 heap corruption at O0/O1 baseline.

SLG ownership cleanup already separates dominating moves from sibling moves and suppresses each transferred field in drop glue. Preserve that per-path policy; actual current Native execution must still prove the Err and Ok cases.

Observed canonical Native IR: finish function body6 operand0=match12; match12 parent=flow8; flow8 parent=body6 operand1=match12; arm body15 -> arm13 -> match12. Current ownership walk demands body.operand0==flow8 and therefore incorrectly reports E20. The canonical selected return is match12, an ancestor of the moving arm, while every traversed arm/flow result slot stays checked.

At a function return boundary require the canonical selected result to contain the moving arm, after validating all intervening result edges and a returned match. An earlier match followed by task.program use is still rejected; explicit returns, mixed Unit joins and branch-local owners retain controls. No AST offset, declared return type, function name or diagnostic suppression fallback.

diagnosticCorrection.decision: Report symmetric differences against the entry mask for loops or the first incoming mask for ordinary joins; identically moved child is not affected. Existing SLG branch-local diagnostics already implement this decision and are preserved.
